subject: Co-term proposal & mid-contract capacity top-up — Medline AI
messages:
From: Jordan Allen <j.allen@medline.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Tasha Rivera <t.rivera@medline.ai>, procurement@medline.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Mid-contract capacity add + co-term ask

Hey Priyom,

Quick context: we're seeing a big uptick in inference usage for our triage product — estimated additional 60M tokens/month starting April. We want to ramp capacity now rather than wait for renewal. Two asks:

1) Can you provide a mid-contract top-up quote (monthly) and an annualized co-term option that moves our renewal to Jan 1 next year?
2) Any flexibility on tiered discounting if we commit to a 12-month uplift starting now? Procurement wants a clear path (MAP, pricing table, timelines).

Attached is a rough forecast. Ideally we close commercial terms this month so procurement can finish PO approvals.

Thanks — appreciate the help.

Jordan
Jordan Allen
Product Lead, Platform
Medline AI
attachments: forecast_q2_q4.xlsx (see referenced numbers)
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Allen <j.allen@medline.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity add + co-term ask

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and the forecast. High level reply: we can support a mid-contract top-up and offer a co-term that aligns your renewal to Jan 1. I sketched two commercial paths below so procurement has something concrete to review.

Option A — Monthly top-up (no annual commitment):
- Add 60M tokens/month at list pricing; standard usage tiers apply.
- No change to renewal date.
- Good if you want flexibility, but unit cost remains higher.

Option B — Mid-contract annualized uplift (recommended):
- Convert the 60M/month uplift into a 12-month commitment effective Apr 1; we co-term renewal to Jan 1 by prorating the remainder.
- 10% volume discount off list for the uplift band (subject to approval).
- We include a one-time implementation credit to offset migration/ops work.

I don't have final approval on the discount slice — looping in Kimberly for approval and Aditya for finance signoff on proration/run rate math.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll upload a mutual action plan (MAP_v2.xlsx) with milestones, PO window, and billing options.
- Kimberly/aditya: can you confirm whether 10% discount on the uplift band is doable, and whether we can extend 30-day invoice terms for procurement?
- Jordan: if procurement needs alternative discount bands (e.g., 12% at 18-month commit), let me know and we can model.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (mutual action plan stub)
From: Tasha Rivera <t.rivera@medline.ai>

Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity add + co-term ask

Thanks Priyom — procurement here. A couple clarifying points so we can fast-track:

- We need the quote to show both (a) monthly top-up pricing with bandwidth caps and (b) annualized uplift pricing that includes the co-term proration and the effective monthly unit rate.
- PO window: we can sign if invoice terms are Net 30 and pricing is locked for 90 days.
- On discounts: our CFO has flagged that anything less than 12% on a 12-month uplift won't clear without executive approval. If you can show a modest additional service credit (implementation/observability credit) that could bridge the delta.

Can you provide the redwood_quote_medline_v3.pdf with those two quote scenarios and the proposed MAP milestones? Procurement would like the doc by EOD Friday so we can circulate internally.

Regards,
Tasha Rivera
Head of Procurement — Medline AI
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Tasha Rivera <t.rivera@medline.ai>, Jordan Allen <j.allen@medline.ai>

Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity add + co-term ask

Tasha — appreciate the clarity. Quick update and what's attached:

- redwood_quote_medline_v3.pdf (attached) contains two line-items: Monthly Top-up (list) and Annualized Uplift (12-month commit, co-term to Jan 1) with proration math spelled out.
- We've modeled two discount bands: 10% (sales-approved) and 12% (requires Ops Exec approval). To help bridge, we added a $8,000 implementation credit tied to the MAP milestones (offset on first invoice).
- Payment terms: Net 30 (we can accommodate). Pricing lock: 60 days — Kimberly, can we extend to 90 for this customer if approved?

Kimberly/aditya: can you confirm approval path? If you greenlight 12% + $8k credit we will mark the quote as exec-approved and send a DocuSign link. Otherwise I’ll proceed with the 10% variant so Tasha/procurement can begin PO paperwork.

Jordan/Tasha: if this looks good I can send the DocuSign and updated MAP today for signatures.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
